title: Windshield wipers and washer spray
summary: Feedback on the G60's windshield wipers and washer system centers on washer spray performance and a few hardware or operation issues, while many sampled mentions are descriptive service notes without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: The lone positive review praises improved washer spray direction for the wipers.

negative.summary: Negative reviews cite a non-spraying washer nozzle, unsatisfactory spray pattern, water reaching the side window, and a loose washer fluid reservoir.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions describe screeching wipers, slow or manual wiper behavior, maintenance-position use, washer design details, and repair outcomes without enough context to confirm overall sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled mentions are undetermined, which limits confident conclusions about overall customer sentiment.
Several examples are brief service descriptions or incomplete statements, so the exact customer evaluation is not always clear.
The topic is somewhat broad, covering washer nozzles, fluid routing, wiper behavior, noises, and repair status rather than one single issue.
